kathaṁkathī puggalo sakaṅkho savilekho sadveḷhako savicikiccho ñāṇādhigamāya ñāṇaphusanāya ñāṇasacchikiriyāya, adhisīlampi sikkheyya, adhicittampi sikkheyya, adhipaññampi sikkheyya, imā tisso sikkhāyo āvajjanto sikkheyya, jānanto sikkheyya, passanto sikkheyya, paccavekkhanto sikkheyya, cittaṁ adhiṭṭhahanto sikkheyya, saddhāya adhimuccanto sikkheyya, vīriyaṁ paggaṇhanto sikkheyya, satiṁ upaṭṭhahanto sikkheyya, cittaṁ samādahanto sikkheyya, paññāya pajānanto sikkheyya, abhiññeyyaṁ abhijānanto sikkheyya, pariññeyyaṁ parijānanto sikkheyya, pahātabbaṁ pajahanto sikkheyya, bhāvetabbaṁ bhāvento sikkheyya, sacchikātabbaṁ sacchikaronto sikkheyya ācareyya samācareyya samādāya vatteyyāti kathaṁkathī ñāṇapathāya sikkhe.

kathaṁkathāhī.g: muñca maṁ pamuñca maṁ mocehi maṁ pamocehi maṁ uddhara maṁ samuddhara maṁ vuṭṭhāpehi maṁ kathaṁkathāsallatoti pamuñca maṁ Sakka kathaṁkathāhi.

kathaṁkathāhi.g: muñca maṁ pamuñca maṁ mocehi maṁ pamocehi maṁ uddhara maṁ samuddhara maṁ vuṭṭhāpehi maṁ kathaṁkathāsallatoti pamuñca maṁ Sakka kathaṁkathāhi.

Kathaṁkathiṁ.g: kathaṁkathiṁ puggalaṁ sakaṅkhaṁ sakhilaṁ sadveḷhakaṁ savicikicchaṁ.

Kathaṁkathā.g: kathaṁkathā ca yo tiṇṇo uttiṇṇo nitthiṇṇo atikkanto samatikkanto vītivattoti kathaṁkathā ca yo tiṇṇo.

kathamahaṁ.g: ahaṁ kathaṁ karissāmi2, kathaṁ jīvissāmīti parihāsakeḷiṁ akāsi.

Kathaṁkaro.g: idaṁ nāgarājā tassa naggassa samaṇabhāvaṁ ñatvā samaṇapaṭipattiṁ pucchanto āha.
kiṁ nāma kammaṁ karonto kiṁ ācaranto kiṁ sevamāno bhajamāno payirupāsamāno idhaloke paññaṁ labhati, paññāyameva1 paṭipadaṁ vadehi, jānitukāmomhi, kathaṁkaro macco paññavā nāma hotīti pucchati.

kathaṁvidhaṁ.g: kathaṁvidhaṁ nu purisaṁ paṭiladdhasirī na jahātīti.
